name: Millennium Dawn
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 >/dev/null; [ "$("$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null)" = "1.3.14" ] || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.14"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; python3 tools/dev_setup.py --docs || test -n "$(git config --get core.hooksPath)"; python3 -m pre_commit --version >/dev/null && python3 -c "import pytest, yaml, requests, PIL" && node --version | grep -qE "^v(2[4-9]|[3-9][0-9])" && [ "$(bun --version)" = "1.3.14" ] && test -d docs/node_modules

terminals.name: docs-dev-server
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; cd docs && exec bun run dev --host
terminals.description: Astro documentation site dev server (http://localhost:4321/Millennium-Dawn/). Restart to preview docs changes.
